demoted._parameter: Python's parameter list is ordered by the grammar itself -- `def f(a=1, b)` and `def f(**kw, a)` are SyntaxErrors from CPython's parser -- so the six parameter node types cannot share one supertype derivation. All six are concrete types occurring nowhere but a parameter list, so facet membership selects the same nodes.
